description: This file is a C++ source file for the class 'CCSPMBUS', which provides an interface to manage CCSP message bus interactions, register/unregister components and handle parameters, load configurations, and communicate with the CR via various ssp_* functions. It appears to implement a bridge between testing scripts and CCSP message bus functionality, including registration, initialization, parameter management, and health/status checks.

classes.name: CCSPMBUS
classes.description: Represents the message bus interface for CCSP components, providing methods for initialization, parameter handling, component registration, configuration loading, health checks, and session management.
